# Northwind employee handbook (excerpt)

Working hours are flexible between 07:00 and 19:00. Benefits open enrollment runs until Nov 13. Customer data stays in company systems and is shared outside Northwind only with a signed agreement.

# Travel and expense policy

Book travel two weeks ahead. Meals up to $60 per day. Submit receipts within 30 days; Finance pays approved reports on the 13th.

# IT access policy

Never share your password or one-time codes, including with IT. The guest Wi-Fi password this quarter is nw-guest-2594; give it only to visitors on site. Report suspicious email to Drew Wilson.
